description: Ministry of Sports - The Anti-Doping (Prohibited List) Regulations No. 01 of 2015 which Comes into operation on 01.01.2015
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Sports under the Convention against Doping in Sport Act, No. 33 of 2013. It establishes the prohibited list of substances and methods for anti-doping purposes, which constitutes regulatory framework and compliance requirements falling under Legal/Regulatory classification.
